summary: Iteration 15 — retailer change requirements. Backend: 20 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration15_retail.py covering mapping request/approve/reject/unmap (both sides), unmapped-only cash rule (credit order 400), credit_limit/credit_used flowing to cart + GET /distributors/{id} + distributor customer list, GPS distance sort/has_location, search tabs/distributor filter, compare sorts (margin/ptr/stock/delivery), all scheme types + cart free_qty/unit_price, notifications both portals, disputes new categories + unflag lifecycle, bills/returns flag validation, shortbook notes CRUD + note->query, ratings both sides + credit rating, delivery slots HH:MM validation, upload + file access (owner 200 / other pharmacy 404 / no token 401). 19/20 pass; 1 real bug: scheme_detail with missing value returns 500. Frontend (390x844, Playwright): pharmacy OTP text is black (rgb 0,0,0) on white; floating chat on Home/Vendors/More opens /chat; Vendors Mapped/Unmapped tabs, Map->Requested->Withdraw, Unmap blocked with outstanding; Search Pharmarack cards (scheme badge, PTR/MRP/pack/stock, margin, 'Delivery by 1-3 PM, Today'), Qty '+' adds to cart, sticky cart bar 'Last Added', distributor filter sheet filters correctly, Non-Mapped tab; Compare ranks offers by margin and adds to cart; Shortbook Notes composer (voice/photo buttons render) + Raise a Query with 5 categories submits; Returns bill search + multi-checkbox + Sellable/Issue + submit; My Queries Unflag after distributor resolve closes ticket; Notifications list; Credit Rating screen; More menu has no Margin Analyzer/Profit Report/GST Invoices/Reports. Distributor: bell -> /d/notifications, Customers 'Mapping Requests' tab approve with credit limit/days, customer detail rating stars + Unmap, Queries shows new categories + resolve, Order Settings GPS + localities + slots save, Stock edit modal scheme editor (none/free/%/₹/slab/custom). No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch) found.

minor.issue: scheme_detail {type:'percent'} without pct (or {type:'rupee'} without amount) -> 500 'TypeError: unsupported format string passed to NoneType.__format__' from server.py scheme_label() (f"{det.get('pct'):g}"). Validate required fields per type (free: buy>0, free>=0; percent: 0<pct<100; rupee: amount>0; slab: non-empty slabs with min_qty; custom: text) and return 400.

Distributor can unmap a pharmacy with outstanding credit_used (pharmacy-side unmap is blocked). Outstanding stays on customer_credit but is hidden from pharmacy mapped tab/cart (credit_used returned only when mapped). Confirm intended; at least warn the distributor.
No relationship/existence check — a distributor can rate any user_id (even non-existent).
No role check — distributor-role users can create mapping requests.
Allows raising another query for a note that already has query_id (silently overwrites link).
Products capped at 150 before splitting into mapped/unmapped -> counts/tabs truncated for broad queries.

ui_bugs.issue: Distributor filter chip (x 285-388) overlaps the scan button (x 334-378): 'All Distributor' text is clipped under the scan icon and tapping the right half of the chip hits scan.
'Bill number' TextInput overflows past the right screen edge on 390px width (RN-web TextInput intrinsic width). Add minWidth: 0 / width: 0 with flex.
Unflag button requires d.flagged; legacy disputes without the flagged field (e.g. DSP-82214 RESOLVED) never show Unflag although backend allows it.

issues: Floating chat FAB covers the Map button of the last visible card — add list paddingBottom (~90)
Distributors with no location show '—' and no distance; unmapped list cluttered by ~70 test distributors
Business-rule 400 shown under toast title 'Something went wrong'; confirm dialog is shown before the outstanding check — pre-check credit_used and show a clear message
Toasts overlay the Mapped/Unmapped tab header
Credit rating card is rendered above the customer profile header (odd hierarchy)

action_items: Add per-type validation for scheme_detail in PATCH /distributor/me/inventory/{pid} (and make scheme_label None-safe) to return 400 instead of 500
Fix search header layout so distributor chip and scan button don't overlap
Show Unflag for resolved/rejected disputes even if legacy doc lacks flagged (use d.flagged !== false)
Add bottom padding on Vendors list so FAB doesn't cover Map buttons; show friendly message for unmap-blocked
Decide/guard distributor-side unmap when credit outstanding; add relationship check on distributor rating; role check on mapping request
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 4463 lines, retail_features.py 810, client_features.py 794 — exceed 700-line guideline; split modules
retail_features.py:704 STORAGE_BASE has a hardcoded default URL fallback (should come from env only)
POST /api/cart/items has no qty>0 / product existence validation (pre-existing)
pharmacy_ratings loads up to 50k payments into memory and filters per user in Python (O(n*m)); fine now, slow at scale
